name: OpenAdapt
tagline: Compile demonstrated GUI workflows into deterministic programs that verify results and halt on uncertainty
seoTitle: OpenAdapt - Verified GUI Automation from Demonstration
metaDescription: OpenAdapt compiles demonstrated browser, desktop, RDP, and Citrix workflows into deterministic programs that verify results and halt on uncertainty.
overview: OpenAdapt turns one demonstrated GUI task into an inspectable program for browser, Windows, macOS, Linux, RDP, or Citrix/VDI. The compiled workflow runs deterministically on its healthy path and makes no generative-model calls.

The runtime retains structural, accessibility, visual, OCR, spatial, and transition evidence from the demonstration. It checks identities before consequential actions and checks the declared result before it reports VERIFIED.

When an interface changes, OpenAdapt first re-resolves the target from retained evidence. A configured model can propose a repair when policy permits, but the repaired version must pass review and qualification before promotion. If the required evidence is missing or disagrees with the live state, the run halts for review.
features: Records browser, native desktop, RDP, and Citrix/VDI demonstrations with retained target evidence
Compiles a recording into an inspectable workflow with explicit steps, guards, identities, and expected effects
Replays healthy workflows deterministically with no generative-model calls
Verifies declared business effects through independent or persisted-state evidence before reporting VERIFIED
Halts on ambiguous identity, uncertain delivery, failed verification, or missing evidence
Supports reviewed, versioned repair proposals when an interface drifts

gettingStarted.intro: OpenAdapt requires Python 3.10-3.12. The bundled quickstart comes with the base package and doesn't need an account or API key.

steps.heading: Install OpenAdapt
steps.body: Install the current launcher and compiler/runtime.

steps.heading: Run the local tutorial
steps.body: Compile, certify, and run the bundled synthetic MockMed workflow. The healthy run returns VERIFIED after a separate read-only API confirms the saved record.

steps.heading: Inspect the compiled workflow
steps.body: Open the program graph and run the static checks against the generated bundle.
steps.code:
openadapt flow visualize openadapt-quickstart/bundle --out graph.html
openadapt flow lint openadapt-quickstart/bundle

steps.heading: Record a browser workflow
steps.body: Use the same compiler/runtime with your own application. Native and remote backends use their matching extras.
steps.code:
openadapt flow record --backend web --url https://your-app.example --out rec
openadapt flow compile rec --out bundle --name my-workflow
openadapt flow replay bundle --url https://your-app.example --run-dir run

useCases: Repeated browser or desktop work where the interface is unavoidable and the result needs proof
Legacy Windows, RDP, Citrix, or VDI tasks with no practical write API
Consequential data entry that needs identity checks and independent effect verification
Stable workflows that should run without paying for or depending on a model at every step
